info.eagerLoadHint: On by default: every subspace starts together with the app, useful for receiving notifications from all of them (e.g. multiple WhatsApp accounts). Turn it off to load them only on first click instead.
info.hibernateDelayHint: Switching to another subspace closes the one you left (freeing memory) after this idle time, unless you come back to it first. 0 = immediately.

security.pinIntro: Require a PIN to open this app.

security.pinLengthError: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits long.
security.ignoreCertErrorsHint: Off by default. Silently accepts expired/self-signed/hostname-mismatched certificates for every subspace of this app, without showing WebView2's warning. Only useful for a local/dev server with a self-signed certificate you know about — don't enable it for public sites: it makes the app vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks on that connection.
